head: Port Things: an offline cruise port guide app for iPhone
dek: Port Things is a new iPhone and iPad app with offline guides to cruise ports, made by Incmplte L.L.C. It costs $4.99 and was #60 among paid Travel apps on the US App Store on 20 November.
details: The price includes five destination guides you choose; more ports or all guides are optional in-app purchases, with no subscription. The app has 20 guides so far, with more promised as free updates. You can pick your pier to see walking times, plan a day around the ship's all-aboard time and follow a compass back to the pier. It needs no account, shows no ads and works in eleven languages.
where: iPhone and iPad (iOS 18 or later), App Store, out since 18 November
means: If you're going on a cruise, you can keep port maps, opening hours and day plans on your phone without needing mobile data in port.
todo: Check the app's list of guides for your itinerary's ports before you buy, and download the guide photos over Wi-Fi before you sail.
